query:
SELECT current_database() AS database_name, current_setting('server_version_num') AS server_version_num, current_user AS database_role,
(SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relkind IN ('r','p')) AS table_count,
(SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_depend d WHERE d.classid='pg_proc'::regclass AND d.objid=p.oid AND d.deptype='e')) AS application_function_count,
(SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_constraint c WHERE c.connamespace='public'::regnamespace AND (NOT c.convalidated OR (to_jsonb(c)->>'conenforced')::boolean = false)) AS unvalidated_or_unenforced_constraints,
(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind',x.relkind,'count',x.n) ORDER BY x.relkind),'[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT c.relkind::text,count(*)::int AS n FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' GROUP BY c.relkind) x) AS relation_kinds,
(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',e.extname,'version',e.extversion) ORDER BY e.extname) FROM pg_extension e) AS extensions
notes: Counts and valid/enforced flags are not definitions equivalence or complete permissions inspection.
Current branch PostgreSQL18.6 and vector0.8.6 differ from native17.11 rehearsal platform; differences require explicit comparison.
